title: The Smudged Date on the Library Card
youtube_title: The Smudged Date on the Library Card | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Hiding a dent does not make the dent untrue.
summary: At a kitchen table with jam, butter, and a shared pencil tin, Idris is tangled up with a library card whose date stamp got smudged and almost hides it. Idris tells Ms. Okonkwo the plain truth, and together they mend what can be mended, with no teasing.
